test("meeting: registered voice gets its name, unknown voices get stable Speaker N labels", async () => {
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title: "Standup" })).data;
  // voice 1 = Asha (enrolled above); voices 2 and 3 are unknown
  const order = [1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 3, 2];
  let t = 0;
  for (const v of order) {
    await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=${t}&end=${t + 2000}`, pcm(v, 2));
    t += 2500;
  }
  // a very short blip right after voice 2
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=${t}&end=${t + 500}`, pcm(2, 0.5));
  const done = await until(async () => {
    const d = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return settled(d) && d;
  });
  const label = new Map(done.speakers.map((s) => [s.id, s.label]));
  const labels = done.segments.map((s) => label.get(s.speakerId));
  assert.deepEqual(labels, ["Asha", "Speaker 1", "Speaker 2", "Speaker 1", "Asha", "Speaker 2", "Speaker 1", "Speaker 1"]);
  assert.equal(done.segments.at(-1).speakerUncertain, true, "short segment flagged");
  assert.equal(done.segments[0].text, "words from voice 1");

  // corrections: rename Speaker 1 everywhere, move one line, merge
  const s1 = done.speakers.find((s) => s.label === "Speaker 1");
  const s2 = done.speakers.find((s) => s.label === "Speaker 2");
  await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/speakers/${s1.id}`, { label: "Ravi" });
  let d = (await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments/${done.segments[2].id}`, { speakerId: s1.id })).data;
  assert.equal(new Map(d.speakers.map((s) => [s.id, s.label])).get(d.segments[2].speakerId), "Ravi");
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/speakers/${s2.id}/merge`, { into: s1.id });
  d = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
  assert.ok(!d.speakers.some((s) => s.id === s2.id));
  d = (await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments/${done.segments[0].id}`, { text: "Corrected text" })).data;
  assert.equal(d.segments[0].text, "Corrected text");

  // the merged voice keeps landing on the merged speaker
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=28000&end=30000`, pcm(3, 2));
  d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return settled(x) && x;
  });
  assert.equal(d.segments.at(-1).speakerId, s1.id, "voice 3 now goes to Ravi");

  // a new unknown voice after a rename is still numbered after the existing ones
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=30000&end=32000`, pcm(4, 2));
  d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return settled(x) && x;
  });
  assert.equal(new Map(d.speakers.map((s) => [s.id, s.label])).get(d.segments.at(-1).speakerId), "Speaker 3", "numbering continues after Speaker 2");

  // export
  const txt = await fetch(`${B}/api/meetings/${m.id}/export?format=txt`);
  assert.match(txt.headers.get("content-disposition"), /Standup\.txt/);
  const body = await txt.text();
  assert.match(body, /\[00:00 - 00:02\] Asha: Corrected text/);
  assert.match(body, /Ravi: words from voice 2/);
  const md = await (await fetch(`${B}/api/meetings/${m.id}/export?format=md`)).text();
  assert.match(md, /^# Standup/);
  const json = JSON.parse(await (await fetch(`${B}/api/meetings/${m.id}/export?format=json`)).text());
  assert.equal(json.segments[0].speaker, "Asha");
});

test("meeting: two people in one piece of speech are split into two lines", async () => {
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title: "Back to back" })).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=1000&end=6000`, turnsPcm([[5, 2.5], [6, 2.5]]));
  const d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.segments.length === 2 && settled(x) && x;
  });
  const label = new Map(d.speakers.map((s) => [s.id, s.label]));
  assert.deepEqual(d.segments.map((s) => label.get(s.speakerId)), ["Speaker 1", "Speaker 2"]);
  assert.deepEqual(d.segments.map((s) => s.text), ["words from voice 5", "words from voice 6"]);
  assert.equal(d.segments[0].startMs, 1000);
  assert.equal(d.segments[1].startMs, 3500, "second line starts where the second voice starts");
  assert.equal(d.segments[1].endMs, 6000);
});

test("voice chat: the speech language setting becomes transcription language codes", async () => {

  assert.deepEqual((await j("GET", "/api/live/setup")).data.languageCodes, [], "automatic by default");

test("meeting: after it ends, one voice split in two is merged back", async () => {
  // very strict matching during the meeting: the same voice gets split into several speakers
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { voiceClusterThreshold: 0.995 });
  noise = 0.25;
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title: "Refine" })).data;
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=${i * 3000}&end=${i * 3000 + 2000}`, pcm(8, 2));
  let d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.segments.length === 4 && settled(x) && x;
  });
  assert.ok(d.speakers.length > 1, "split during the meeting");
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { voiceClusterThreshold: 0.55 });
  noise = 0.15;
  await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`, { ended: true });
  d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.refined && x;
  });
  assert.equal(d.speakers.length, 1, "merged after the meeting");
  assert.equal(new Set(d.segments.map((s) => s.speakerId)).size, 1);
  assert.equal(d.speakers[0].segments, 4);
});

test("voice profiles from an older model are flagged and not used", async () => {
  const p = (await j("POST", "/api/speakers?name=Old&consent=yes", pcm(9, 10))).data;
  assert.equal(p.outdated, false);
  const { db } = await import("../db.mjs");
  db.prepare("UPDATE speaker_profiles SET model = 'old-model' WHERE id = ?").run(p.id);
  assert.equal((await j("GET", "/api/speakers")).data.find((x) => x.id === p.id).outdated, true);
  assert.ok(!(await j("POST", "/api/speakers/identify", pcm(9, 3))).data.some((x) => x.name === "Old"));
  // re-recording replaces the voiceprint in place
  const r = (await j("POST", `/api/speakers?name=Old&consent=yes&replace=${p.id}`, pcm(9, 10))).data;
  assert.equal(r.id, p.id);
  assert.equal(r.outdated, false);
});

// a finished, transcribed two-person meeting that started at `startedAt`
async function finishedMeeting(title, startedAt) {
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title })).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=0&end=5000`, turnsPcm([[21, 2.5], [22, 2.5]]));
  await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.segments.length === 2 && settled(x);
  });
  if (startedAt) {
    const { db } = await import("../db.mjs");
    db.prepare("UPDATE meetings SET started_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(startedAt, m.id);
  }
  return m;
}

test("meeting: when it ends, durable facts go to memory, linked to the meeting", async () => {
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { confirmMemoryChanges: false, userName: "Soubh" });
  nextMeetingOps = [{ action: "add", content: "In the meeting on 7 Oct 2026, Speaker 2 agreed to send the budget by Friday.", category: "work" }];
  const m = await finishedMeeting("Budget sync");
  await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`, { ended: true });
  const d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.memoryStatus === "done" && x;
  });
  assert.equal(d.memoryCount, 1);
  const call = geminiCalls.json.findLast((c) => /transcript of a meeting/.test(c.system));
  assert.match(call.prompt, /Speaker 1: words from voice 21/);
  assert.match(call.prompt, /Speaker 2: words from voice 22/);
  assert.match(call.prompt, /The user's name is Soubh/);
  assert.match(call.prompt, /Meeting date:/);
  const memo = (await j("GET", "/api/memories")).data.find((x) => /send the budget/.test(x.content));
  assert.equal(memo.meetingId, m.id);
  assert.equal(memo.source, "meeting");
  // the assistant's brief for this meeting lists it
  const brief = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/brief`)).data;
  assert.deepEqual(brief.memoriesFromThisMeeting, [memo.content]);
  assert.match(brief.transcript, /Speaker 2: words from voice 22/);
  nextMeetingOps = [];
});

test("meeting: memory from meetings can be switched off and run by hand", async () => {
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { meetingMemory: false });
  const calls = geminiCalls.json.length;
  const m = await finishedMeeting("Quiet one");
  await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`, { ended: true });
  const d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.refined && x.memoryStatus && x;
  });
  assert.equal(d.memoryStatus, "off");
  assert.equal(geminiCalls.json.length, calls, "nothing sent to Gemini");
  nextMeetingOps = [{ action: "add", content: "In the meeting on 7 Oct 2026, the team chose Goa for the offsite.", category: "plan" }];
  const after = (await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/memorize`)).data;
  assert.equal(after.memoryStatus, "done");
  assert.equal(after.memoryCount, 1);
  nextMeetingOps = [{ action: "forget", memory_id: 1 }];
  const again = (await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/memorize`)).data;
  assert.equal(again.memoryCount, 0, "meetings never delete memories");
  nextMeetingOps = [];
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { meetingMemory: true });
});

test("meeting: minutes are written, stored, exported and name an untitled meeting", async () => {
  const m = await finishedMeeting(""); // automatic "Meeting <date>" title
  assert.match(m.title, /^Meeting \d/);
  nextMinutes = {
    suggested_title: "Offsite planning",
    summary: "The team planned the offsite.",
    key_points: ["Goa is preferred"],
    decisions: ["Offsite in Goa"],
    action_items: [{ task: "Book flights", owner: "Speaker 2", due: "2026-10-20" }, { task: "" }],
    open_questions: [],
  };
  const d = (await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/minutes`)).data;
  assert.equal(d.title, "Offsite planning");
  assert.equal(d.minutes.summary, "The team planned the offsite.");
  assert.deepEqual(d.minutes.actionItems, [{ task: "Book flights", owner: "Speaker 2", due: "2026-10-20" }]);
  assert.ok(d.minutesAt);
  const call = geminiCalls.json.at(-1);
  assert.match(call.prompt, /\[00:00\] Speaker \d: words from voice 21/);
  const md = await fetch(`${B}/api/meetings/${m.id}/export?format=md`).then((r) => r.text());
  assert.match(md, /## Minutes of meeting/);
  assert.match(md, /Book flights \| owner: Speaker 2 \| due: 2026-10-20/);
  assert.match(md, /## Transcript/);
  // a title the user chose is kept
  await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`, { title: "My name" });
  nextMinutes = { ...nextMinutes, suggested_title: "Something else" };
  assert.equal((await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/minutes`)).data.title, "My name");
  assert.equal((await j("DELETE", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/minutes`)).data.minutes, null);
  // nothing to summarise
  const empty = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title: "Empty" })).data;
  assert.equal((await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${empty.id}/minutes`)).status, 400);
});

test("meetings can be found by date range and topic", async () => {
  const day = (y, mo, d, h = 10) => new Date(y, mo - 1, d, h).getTime();
  const wed = await finishedMeeting("Design review", day(2026, 10, 7));
  const thu = await finishedMeeting("Hiring chat", day(2026, 10, 8));
  const range = (a, b) => `/api/meetings/find?from=${a}&to=${b}`;
  // "last Wednesday" = 7 Oct 2026, local day
  let r = (await j("GET", range(day(2026, 10, 7, 0), day(2026, 10, 8, 0) - 1))).data;
  assert.deepEqual(r.meetings.map((x) => x.id), [wed.id]);
  assert.match(r.meetings[0].when, /Wednesday,? 7 October 2026/);
  assert.deepEqual(r.meetings[0].participants.sort(), ["Speaker 1", "Speaker 2"]);
  assert.match(r.meetings[0].preview, /words from voice/);
  r = (await j("GET", range(day(2026, 10, 7, 0), day(2026, 10, 9, 0)))).data;
  assert.deepEqual(r.meetings.map((x) => x.id), [thu.id, wed.id], "newest first");
  // topic inside the range
  r = (await j("GET", range(day(2026, 10, 7, 0), day(2026, 10, 9, 0)) + "&q=hiring")).data;
  assert.equal(r.matchedQuery, true);
  assert.deepEqual(r.meetings.map((x) => x.id), [thu.id]);
  // unknown topic: falls back to the date range
  r = (await j("GET", range(day(2026, 10, 7, 0), day(2026, 10, 9, 0)) + "&q=zebra")).data;
  assert.equal(r.matchedQuery, false);
  assert.equal(r.meetings.length, 2);
  // a day without meetings
  assert.deepEqual((await j("GET", range(day(2026, 10, 1, 0), day(2026, 10, 2, 0)))).data.meetings, []);
  // the assistant is told the current date and how to look meetings up
  const setup = (await j("GET", "/api/live/setup")).data;
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, /Right now it is \w+day,? \d+ \w+ \d{4}/);
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, /find_meetings/);
});


// ---- documents ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// a tiny ZIP writer (deflate) so the tests can build real .docx/.pptx/.xlsx files
const zlib = await import("node:zlib");
function makeZip(files) {
  const locals = [], centrals = [];
  let off = 0;
  for (const [name, content] of Object.entries(files)) {
    const data = Buffer.from(content, "utf8");
    const comp = zlib.deflateRawSync(data);
    const crc = zlib.crc32(data);
    const n = Buffer.from(name);
    const lh = Buffer.alloc(30);
    lh.writeUInt32LE(0x04034b50, 0); lh.writeUInt16LE(20, 4); lh.writeUInt16LE(8, 8);
    lh.writeUInt32LE(crc, 14); lh.writeUInt32LE(comp.length, 18); lh.writeUInt32LE(data.length, 22); lh.writeUInt16LE(n.length, 26);
    const ch = Buffer.alloc(46);
    ch.writeUInt32LE(0x02014b50, 0); ch.writeUInt16LE(20, 4); ch.writeUInt16LE(20, 6); ch.writeUInt16LE(8, 10);
    ch.writeUInt32LE(crc, 16); ch.writeUInt32LE(comp.length, 20); ch.writeUInt32LE(data.length, 24); ch.writeUInt16LE(n.length, 28); ch.writeUInt32LE(off, 42);
    locals.push(lh, n, comp);
    centrals.push(ch, n);
    off += 30 + n.length + comp.length;
  }
  const cd = Buffer.concat(centrals);
  const end = Buffer.alloc(22);
  end.writeUInt32LE(0x06054b50, 0); end.writeUInt16LE(centrals.length / 2, 8); end.writeUInt16LE(centrals.length / 2, 10);
  end.writeUInt32LE(cd.length, 12); end.writeUInt32LE(off, 16);
  return Buffer.concat([...locals, cd, end]);
}

test("documents: text comes out of Word, PowerPoint, Excel and CSV files", async () => {
  const { extractText, classify } = await import("../doc-text.mjs");
  const docx = makeZip({ "word/document.xml": `<w:document><w:body><w:p><w:r><w:t>Monthly rent:</w:t></w:r><w:r><w:tab/><w:t>25,000 &amp; deposit</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tr><w:tc><w:p><w:t>Start</w:t></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:p><w:t>1 Nov</w:t></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl></w:body></w:document>` });
  const t = extractText("lease.docx", docx);
  assert.match(t, /Monthly rent:\t25,000 & deposit/);
  assert.match(t, /Start/);
  assert.match(t, /1 Nov/);

  const pptx = makeZip({
    "ppt/slides/slide2.xml": `<p:sld><a:p><a:r><a:t>Second slide</a:t></a:r></a:p></p:sld>`,
    "ppt/slides/slide10.xml": `<p:sld><a:p><a:t>Tenth</a:t></a:p></p:sld>`,
    "ppt/slides/slide1.xml": `<p:sld><a:p><a:t>Title slide</a:t></a:p><a:p><a:t>Q3 results</a:t></a:p></p:sld>`,
  });
  const p = extractText("deck.pptx", pptx);
  assert.ok(p.indexOf("Title slide") < p.indexOf("Second slide") && p.indexOf("Second slide") < p.indexOf("Tenth"), "slides in numeric order");
  assert.match(p, /--- Slide 1 ---\nTitle slide\nQ3 results/);

  const xlsx = makeZip({
    "xl/workbook.xml": `<workbook><sheets><sheet name="Budget" sheetId="1" r:id="rId1"/></sheets></workbook>`,
    "xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels": `<Relationships><Relationship Id="rId1" Target="worksheets/sheet1.xml"/></Relationships>`,
    "xl/sharedStrings.xml": `<sst><si><t>Item</t></si><si><t>Cost</t></si><si><r><t>Ren</t></r><r><t>t</t></r></si></sst>`,
    "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml": `<worksheet><sheetData><row r="1"><c r="A1" t="s"><v>0</v></c><c r="B1" t="s"><v>1</v></c></row><row r="2"><c r="A2" t="s"><v>2</v></c><c r="C2"><v>25000</v></c></row><row r="3"><c r="A3" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Food</t></is></c><c r="B3"/></row></sheetData></worksheet>`,
  });
  const x = extractText("budget.xlsx", xlsx);
  assert.match(x, /--- Sheet: Budget ---\nItem\tCost\nRent\t\t25000\nFood/);

  assert.equal(extractText("a.csv", Buffer.from("ï»¿name,age\nA,3\n")), "name,age\nA,3");
  assert.equal(classify("x.pdf").kind, "pdf");
  assert.equal(classify("x.JPG").kind, "image");
  assert.match(classify("old.doc").error, /\.docx/);
  assert.match(classify("thing.exe").error, /aren't supported/);
  const { unzip } = await import("../doc-text.mjs");
  assert.throws(() => unzip(Buffer.from("not a zip at all, definitely not")), /not a valid Office file/);
});

test("documents: added to a conversation, read once, asked about, removed with it", async () => {
  const conv = (await j("POST", "/api/conversations")).data;
  const before = geminiCalls.json.length;
  const pdf = Buffer.from("%PDF-1.4 fake rental agreement");
  const up = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=${encodeURIComponent("Lease 2026.pdf")}`, pdf);
  assert.equal(up.status, 200, up.text);
  const docId = up.data.document.id;
  assert.equal(up.data.document.status, "analysing");
  assert.equal(up.data.message.modality, "document");
  assert.deepEqual(up.data.message.document, { id: docId, name: "Lease 2026.pdf" });

  const ready = await until(async () => {
    const d = (await j("GET", `/api/documents/${docId}`)).data;
    return d.status === "ready" && d;
  });
  assert.equal(ready.analysis.docType, "contract");
  assert.deepEqual(ready.analysis.suggestedQuestions, ["When does it end?"]);
  assert.equal(ready.analysis.pages, 2);
  const readCall = geminiCalls.json.slice(before).find((c) => /You read documents/.test(c.system));
  const inline = readCall.parts.find((p) => p.inlineData);
  assert.equal(inline.inlineData.mimeType, "application/pdf");
  assert.equal(Buffer.from(inline.inlineData.data, "base64").toString(), pdf.toString(), "the PDF itself goes to Gemini");

  // the attachment is part of the conversation
  const c = (await j("GET", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}`)).data;
  assert.equal(c.messages.at(-1).document.id, docId);

  // a text document: its text goes to Gemini, not the file
  const md = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=notes.md`, Buffer.from("# Notes\nThe deposit is two months of rent."));
  assert.equal(md.status, 200);
  await until(async () => (await j("GET", `/api/documents/${md.data.document.id}`)).data.status === "ready");

  // asking: one document, or all of them
  const one = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents/ask`, { question: "How much is the rent?", documentId: docId });
  assert.equal(one.status, 200, one.text);
  assert.equal(one.data.found, true);
  assert.match(one.data.answer, /25,000/);
  assert.equal(one.data.quotes[0].where, "page 1");
  let ask = geminiCalls.json.at(-1);
  assert.match(ask.parts.at(-1).text, /How much is the rent/);
  assert.equal(ask.parts.filter((p) => p.inlineData).length, 1);
  assert.ok(!ask.parts.some((p) => /deposit is two months/.test(p.text || "")), "only the chosen document");
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents/ask`, { question: "What is the deposit?" });
  ask = geminiCalls.json.at(-1);
  assert.ok(ask.parts.some((p) => /deposit is two months/.test(p.text || "")) && ask.parts.some((p) => p.inlineData), "all documents");

  // the assistant is told about them
  const setup = (await j("GET", `/api/live/setup?conversation=${conv.id}`)).data;
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, new RegExp(`document_id ${docId}: "Lease 2026.pdf" \\(PDF\\) â€” contract, A one-year rental agreement`));
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, /call ask_document/);

  // files that can't be used are refused with a clear reason
  const bad = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=old.doc`, Buffer.from("x"));
  assert.equal(bad.status, 415);
  assert.match(bad.data.error, /Save it as \.docx/);
  const big = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=scan.png`, Buffer.alloc(15 * 1024 * 1024, 1));
  assert.equal(big.status, 413);
  assert.match(big.data.error, /limit for this type is 14 MB/);
  const empty = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=empty.txt`, Buffer.from("   \n  "));
  assert.equal(empty.status, 422);

  // a failed read can be retried
  docFail = true;
  const f = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=photo.jpg`, Buffer.from([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 1, 2]));
  const failed = await until(async () => {
    const d = (await j("GET", `/api/documents/${f.data.document.id}`)).data;
    return d.status === "error" && d;
  });
  assert.match(failed.error, /model unavailable/);
  docFail = false;
  await j("POST", `/api/documents/${f.data.document.id}/retry`);
  await until(async () => (await j("GET", `/api/documents/${f.data.document.id}`)).data.status === "ready");

  // the original can be downloaded
  const file = await fetch(`${B}/api/documents/${docId}/file`);
  assert.equal(Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer()).toString(), pdf.toString());
  assert.match(file.headers.get("content-disposition"), /Lease%202026\.pdf/);

  // removing one document, then the whole conversation, removes the stored files
  const docsDir = path.join(dataDir, "documents");
  const n = fs.readdirSync(docsDir).length;
  assert.equal((await j("DELETE", `/api/documents/${md.data.document.id}`)).data.deleted, true);
  assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(docsDir).length, n - 1);
  await j("DELETE", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}`);
  assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(docsDir).length, 0);
  assert.equal((await j("GET", `/api/documents/${docId}`)).status, 404);
});

test("data can be deleted", async () => {
  const r = (await j("DELETE", "/api/data")).data;
  assert.ok(r.memories >= 1 && r.meetings >= 1 && r.profiles >= 1);
  assert.deepEqual((await j("GET", "/api/memories")).data, []);
  assert.deepEqual((await j("GET", "/api/speakers")).data, []);
});

FILE: server/tests/turns.test.mjs
================================================
// Unit tests for turning pyannote frame regions into speaker turns.
import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { regionsToTurns } from "../models.mjs";

// powerset ids: 0 silence, 1-3 one speaker, 4 = speakers 0+1, 5 = 0+2, 6 = 1+2
const r = (id, start, end) => ({ id, start, end });

test("one speaker covers the whole clip", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(regionsToTurns([r(0, 0, 0.3), r(1, 0.3, 4.5), r(0, 4.5, 5)], 5), [{ start: 0, end: 5, local: 0 }]);
});

test("a speaker change is cut in the middle of the pause", () => {
  const t = regionsToTurns([r(1, 0, 2), r(0, 2, 2.4), r(2, 2.4, 5)], 5);
  assert.equal(t.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(t.map((x) => x.local), [0, 1]);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(t[0].end - 2.2) < 1e-9 && t[1].start === t[0].end && t[1].end === 5);
});

test("short blips and overlaps don't create extra turns", () => {
  // 0.2 s of speaker 2 inside speaker 1, then an overlap that continues speaker 1
  const t = regionsToTurns([r(1, 0, 2), r(2, 2, 2.2), r(1, 2.2, 3), r(4, 3, 3.5), r(1, 3.5, 4)], 4);
  assert.deepEqual(t, [{ start: 0, end: 4, local: 0 }]);
});

test("the same speaker coming back keeps the same local index", () => {
  const t = regionsToTurns([r(1, 0, 1.5), r(2, 1.5, 3), r(1, 3, 4.5)], 4.5);
  assert.deepEqual(t.map((x) => x.local), [0, 1, 0]);
});

test("silence only falls back to one turn", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(regionsToTurns([r(0, 0, 3)], 3), [{ start: 0, end: 3, local: 0 }]);
});

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import "./App.scss";
import { LiveAPIProvider } from "./contexts/LiveAPIContext";
import Sidebar, { View } from "./components/Sidebar";
import AssistantView from "./views/AssistantView";
import MemoryView from "./views/MemoryView";
import MeetingView from "./views/MeetingView";
import SettingsPanel from "./components/SettingsPanel";
import { api, Health } from "./lib/api";

function App() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("assistant");
  const [historyId, setHistoryId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [settingsOpen, setSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [health, setHealth] = useState<Health | null>(null);
  const [serverDown, setServerDown] = useState(false);
  const [historyVersion, setHistoryVersion] = useState(0);

  const refreshHealth = useCallback(() => {
    api
      .get<Health>("/api/health")
      .then((h) => {
        setHealth(h);
        setServerDown(false);
      })
      .catch(() => setServerDown(true));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshHealth();
    const t = setInterval(refreshHealth, 8000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [refreshHealth]);

  const openHistory = (id: number | null) => {
    setHistoryId(id);
    setView("assistant");
  };

  return (
    <LiveAPIProvider>
      <div className="app">
        <Sidebar
          view={view}
          onView={(v) => {
            setView(v);
            if (v === "assistant") setHistoryId(null);
          }}
          historyId={historyId}
          onOpenHistory={openHistory}
          historyVersion={historyVersion}
          onOpenSettings={() => setSettingsOpen(true)}
          memoryReviews={health?.memoryReviews ?? 0}
        />
        <main className="main">
          {(serverDown || (health && !health.hasKey)) && (
            <div className="banner banner--warn" role="alert">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined">warning</span>
              {serverDown ? (
                <span>
                  The AURA server isn't running, so chat, memory and meetings are unavailable. Start everything with{" "}
                  <code>npm run dev</code>.
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span>
                  No Gemini API key found. Add <code>GEMINI_API_KEY=â€¦</code> to the <code>.env</code> file in the project
                  folder and restart the server.
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {view === "assistant" && (
            <AssistantView
              historyId={historyId}
              onCloseHistory={() => setHistoryId(null)}
              onHistoryChanged={() => setHistoryVersion((v) => v + 1)}
              historyVersion={historyVersion}
              memoryReviews={health?.memoryReviews ?? 0}
            />
          )}
          {view === "memory" && <MemoryView onReviewed={refreshHealth} />}
          {/* kept mounted so a meeting keeps recording while you look at other pages */}
          <MeetingView health={health} hidden={view !== "meeting"} />
        </main>
        <SettingsPanel
          open={settingsOpen}
          onClose={() => setSettingsOpen(false)}
          health={health}
          onDataChanged={() => {
            setHistoryVersion((v) => v + 1);
            refreshHealth();
          }}
        />
      </div>
    </LiveAPIProvider>
  );
}

export default App;

FILE: src/components/ConfirmButton.tsx
================================================
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";

/** Two-step destructive button: first click arms it, second click confirms. */
export default function ConfirmButton({
  onConfirm,
  label,
  confirmLabel = "Confirm",
  icon = "delete",
  small,
  iconOnly,
  disabled,
}: {
  onConfirm: () => void | Promise<void>;
  label: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  icon?: string;
  small?: boolean;
  iconOnly?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const [armed, setArmed] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!armed) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setArmed(false), 4000);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [armed]);

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={cn(iconOnly && !armed ? "icon-button" : "btn btn--ghost", "btn--danger", { "btn--small": small, "is-armed": armed })}
      disabled={disabled || busy}
      title={armed ? confirmLabel : label}
      aria-label={armed ? confirmLabel : label}
      onClick={async () => {
        if (!armed) return setArmed(true);
        setBusy(true);
        try {
          await onConfirm();
        } finally {
          setBusy(false);
          setArmed(false);
        }
      }}
    >
      <span className="material-symbols-outlined">{icon}</span>
      {(!iconOnly || armed) && <span>{armed ? confirmLabel : label}</span>}
    </button>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/ConversationActions.tsx
================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";
import { api, downloadFile } from "../lib/api";
import ConfirmButton from "./ConfirmButton";

type Conv = { id: number; title: string; pinned: boolean };

/** Editable title plus pin, export and delete for one conversation. */
export function ConversationTitle({ conv, onChanged }: { conv: Conv; onChanged: () => void }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [value, setValue] = useState(conv.title);
  useEffect(() => setValue(conv.title), [conv.title]);

  const save = async () => {
    setEditing(false);
    const t = value.trim();
    if (t === conv.title) return;
    await api.patch(`/api/conversations/${conv.id}`, { title: t }).catch(() => {});
    onChanged();
  };

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <input
        className="title-input conv-title__input"
        value={value}
        autoFocus
        maxLength={120}
        onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={save}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter") e.currentTarget.blur();
          if (e.key === "Escape") {
            setValue(conv.title);
            setEditing(false);
          }
        }}
        aria-label="Conversation name"
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <h1 className="conv-title">
      <button className="conv-title__btn" onClick={() => setEditing(true)} title="Rename">
        <span className="conv-title__text">{conv.title}</span>
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined conv-title__icon">edit</span>
      </button>
    </h1>
  );
}

export function ConversationActions({
  conv,
  onChanged,
  onDeleted,
  canDelete = true,
}: {
  conv: Conv;
  onChanged: () => void;
  onDeleted?: () => void;
  canDelete?: boolean;
}) {
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menu) return;
    const close = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!ref.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setMenu(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", close);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", close);
  }, [menu]);

  const togglePin = async () => {
    await api.patch(`/api/conversations/${conv.id}`, { pinned: !conv.pinned }).catch(() => {});
    onChanged();
  };

  return (
    <div className="conv-actions">
      <button
        className={cn("icon-button", { "is-on": conv.pinned })}
        onClick={togglePin}
        aria-pressed={conv.pinned}
        title={conv.pinned ? "Unpin" : "Pin to the top of the list"}
        aria-label={conv.pinned ? "Unpin conversation" : "Pin conversation"}
      >
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined">keep</span>
      </button>
      <div className="menu-wrap" ref={ref}>
        <button className="icon-button" onClick={() => setMenu((m) => !m)} aria-expanded={menu} aria-haspopup="menu" title="Export" aria-label="Export conversation">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined">download</span>
        </button>
        {menu && (
          <div className="menu" role="menu">
            {(
              [
                ["md", "Markdown (.md)"],
                ["txt", "Plain text (.txt)"],
                ["json", "JSON (.json)"],
              ] as const
            ).map(([fmt, label]) => (
              <button
                key={fmt}
                role="menuitem"
                onClick={() => {
                  setMenu(false);
                  downloadFile(`/api/conversations/${conv.id}/export?format=${fmt}`, `conversation.${fmt}`).catch((e: Error) => alert(e.message));
                }}
              >
                {label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {canDelete && onDeleted && (
        <ConfirmButton
          small
          iconOnly
          onConfirm={async () => {
            await api.del(`/api/conversations/${conv.id}`);
            onDeleted();
          }}
          label="Delete conversation"
          confirmLabel="Delete for good"
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/Documents.tsx

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";
import { DOCUMENT_ACCEPT, DOCUMENT_LIMIT_MB, DocumentInfo } from "../lib/api";

export const fileSize = (n: number) =>
  n < 1024 ? `${n} B` : n < 1048576 ? `${Math.round(n / 1024)} KB` : `${(n / 1048576).toFixed(n < 10485760 ? 1 : 0)} MB`;

function docIcon(d: { name: string; kind?: string }) {
  const e = d.name.toLowerCase().split(".").pop();
  if (e === "pdf") return "picture_as_pdf";
  if (e === "pptx") return "slideshow";
  if (e === "xlsx" || e === "csv" || e === "tsv") return "table_chart";
  if (d.kind === "image" || /^(png|jpe?g|webp|hei[cf])$/.test(e || "")) return "image";
  if (e === "docx") return "description";
  return "article";
}

/** A document the user added, shown in the conversation. */
export function DocumentCard({
  name,
  doc,
  onAsk,
  onRetry,
}: {
  name: string;
  doc?: DocumentInfo;
  onAsk?: (question: string) => void;
  onRetry?: () => void;
}) {
  const a = doc?.analysis;
  const meta = doc ? [doc.label, fileSize(doc.size), a?.pages ? `${a.pages} page${a.pages === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : null].filter(Boolean).join(" Â· ") : null;
  return (
    <article className={cn("doc-card", { "doc-card--gone": !doc })}>
      <header className="doc-card__head">
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined doc-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">
          {docIcon({ name, kind: doc?.kind })}
        </span>
        <div className="doc-card__title">
          {doc ? (
            <a href={`/api/documents/${doc.id}/file`} download={doc.name} title="Download the original">
              {name}
            </a>
          ) : (
            <span>{name}</span>
          )}
          <span className="doc-card__meta">{doc ? meta : "Removed from this conversation"}</span>
        </div>
      </header>

      {doc?.status === "analysing" && (
        <p className="doc-card__status">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined spin" aria-hidden="true">progress_activity</span>
          Reading the documentâ€¦
        </p>
      )}
      {doc?.status === "error" && (
        <p className="doc-card__status doc-card__status--error">
          <span>Couldn't read it: {doc.error}</span>
          {onRetry && (
            <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" onClick={onRetry}>
              Try again
            </button>
          )}
        </p>
      )}
      {doc?.status === "ready" && a && (
        <>
          <p className="doc-card__overview">{a.overview}</p>
          {a.keyPoints.length > 0 && (
            <details className="doc-card__points">
              <summary>Key points</summary>
              <ul>
                {a.keyPoints.map((k, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>{k}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </details>
          )}
          {doc.truncated && <p className="doc-card__note">This document is long, so only its first part is used for answers.</p>}
          {onAsk && a.suggestedQuestions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="doc-card__ask" aria-label="Ask about this document">
              {a.suggestedQuestions.map((q) => (
                <button key={q} className="chip" onClick={() => onAsk(q)}>
                  {q}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

/** Paperclip button that opens a panel above the message box: add, see and remove documents. */
export function AttachMenu({
  documents,
  onAdd,
  onRemove,
}: {
  documents: DocumentInfo[];
  onAdd: (files: File[]) => Promise<{ name: string; error: string }[]>;
  onRemove: (id: number) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<{ name: string; error: string }[]>([]);
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const close = (e: MouseEvent) => !wrap.current?.contains(e.target as Node) && setOpen(false);
    const esc = (e: globalThis.KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && setOpen(false);
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", close);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", esc);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", close);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", esc);
    };
  }, [open]);

  const add = async (files: File[]) => {
    if (!files.length) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setErrors([]);
    try {
      const failed = await onAdd(files);
      setErrors(failed);
      if (!failed.length) setOpen(false);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      if (input.current) input.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="attach" ref={wrap}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className={cn("icon-button attach__button", { "is-on": open })}
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        title="Add documents"
        aria-label={documents.length ? `Documents (${documents.length})` : "Add documents"}
      >
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined">attach_file</span>
        {documents.length > 0 && <span className="attach__count">{documents.length}</span>}
      </button>
      <input
        ref={input}
        type="file"
        multiple
        accept={DOCUMENT_ACCEPT}
        hidden
        onChange={(e) => add(Array.from(e.target.files || []))}
      />
      {open && (
        <div className="attach__panel" role="dialog" aria-label="Documents in this conversation">
          <div className="attach__head">
            <strong>Documents in this conversation</strong>
            <button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} aria-label="Close">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined">expand_more</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          {documents.length > 0 ? (
            <ul className="attach__list">
              {documents.map((d) => (
                <li key={d.id}>
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined attach__icon" aria-hidden="true">
                    {docIcon(d)}
                  </span>
                  <span className="attach__name">
                    <span title={d.name}>{d.name}</span>
                    <small>
                      {d.status === "analysing" ? "Readingâ€¦" : d.status === "error" ? "Couldn't read it" : `${d.label} Â· ${fileSize(d.size)}`}
                    </small>
                  </span>
                  <button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={() => onRemove(d.id)} title="Remove from this conversation" aria-label={`Remove ${d.name}`}>
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined">close</span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : (
            <p className="attach__empty">Add a document and ask AURA about it, by voice or by typing.</p>
          )}
          {errors.length > 0 && (
            <ul className="attach__errors" role="alert">
              {errors.map((e) => (
                <li key={e.name}>
                  <strong>{e.name}:</strong> {e.error}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
          <div className="attach__foot">
            <button type="button" className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => input.current?.click()}>
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined">{busy ? "progress_activity" : "upload_file"}</span>
              {busy ? "Addingâ€¦" : "Add files"}
            </button>
            <span className="attach__hint">
              PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, text or images, up to {DOCUMENT_LIMIT_MB.inline} MB. You can also drop files into the chat.
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import cn from "classnames";

/**
 * AURA's logo (public/logo-mark.png) with a soft turning halo behind it.
 * The halo glows brighter with `level` (voice activity) while a session is live.
 */
export default function Logo({ size = 34, level = 0, live = false, wordmark = true }: { size?: number; level?: number; live?: boolean; wordmark?: boolean }) {
  const l = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, level));
  return (
    <span className={cn("logo", { "logo--live": live })} style={{ ["--logo-size" as any]: `${size}px`, ["--level" as any]: l.toFixed(3) }}>
      <span className="logo__mark" aria-hidden="true">
        <span className="logo__glow" />
        <img className="logo__img" src={`${process.env.PUBLIC_URL || ""}/logo-mark.png`} alt="" draggable={false} />
      </span>
      {wordmark && <span className="logo__word">AURA</span>}
    </span>
  );
}



================================================
FILE: src/components/MeetingNotes.tsx
================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import { api, Meeting } from "../lib/api";
import { relativeTime } from "../lib/format";

/**
 * After a meeting: minutes of meeting (on request) and what went into long-term memory.
 * `transcriptBusy`: lines are still being transcribed.
 */
export default function MeetingNotes({
  m,
  transcriptBusy,
  onUpdated,
  onError,
}: {
  m: Meeting;
  transcriptBusy: boolean;
  onUpdated: (m: Meeting) => void;
  onError: (e: string) => void;
}) {
  const [writing, setWriting] = useState(false);
  const [memorizing, setMemorizing] = useState(false);
  const lines = m.segments.filter((s) => s.text?.trim()).length;
  if (!lines) return null;

  const write = async () => {
    setWriting(true);
    try {
      onUpdated(await api.post<Meeting>(`/api/meetings/${m.id}/minutes`));
    } catch (e: any) {
      onError(`Couldn't write the minutes. ${e.message}`);
    } finally {
      setWriting(false);
    }
  };
  const remove = async () => {
    try {
      onUpdated(await api.del<Meeting>(`/api/meetings/${m.id}/minutes`));
    } catch (e: any) {
      onError(e.message);
    }
  };
  const memorize = async () => {
    setMemorizing(true);
    try {
      onUpdated(await api.post<Meeting>(`/api/meetings/${m.id}/memorize`));
    } catch (e: any) {
      onError(`Couldn't update memory. ${e.message}`);
    } finally {
      setMemorizing(false);
    }
  };

  const mi = m.minutes;
  const newer = mi ? lines - mi.lines : 0;

  return (
    <section className="notes" aria-label="Minutes and memory">
      {!mi ? (
        <div className="notes__ask">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined notes__icon" aria-hidden="true">summarize</span>
          <div className="notes__ask-text">
            <strong>Minutes of meeting</strong>
            <span>{transcriptBusy ? "Available once the transcript is finished." : "A summary, decisions, action items and open questions from this transcript."}</span>
          </div>
          <button className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={writing || transcriptBusy} onClick={write}>
            {writing ? "Writing minutesâ€¦" : "Write minutes"}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <article className="minutes">
          <header className="minutes__head">
            <h2>Minutes of meeting</h2>
            <span className="muted">Written {m.minutesAt ? relativeTime(m.minutesAt) : ""}</span>
            <span className="minutes__actions">
              <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" disabled={writing || transcriptBusy} onClick={write}>
                {writing ? "Rewritingâ€¦" : "Rewrite"}
              </button>
              <button className="icon-button" onClick={remove} title="Remove the minutes" aria-label="Remove the minutes">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined">close</span>
              </button>
            </span>
          </header>
          {newer > 0 && (
            <p className="minutes__stale">
              {newer} line{newer === 1 ? " was" : "s were"} added or fixed since these were written. Rewrite to include {newer === 1 ? "it" : "them"}.
            </p>
          )}
          {mi.summary && <p className="minutes__summary">{mi.summary}</p>}
          <div className="minutes__grid">
            <MinutesList title="Decisions" items={mi.decisions} />
            <MinutesList title="Key points" items={mi.keyPoints} />
            {mi.actionItems.length > 0 && (
              <div className="minutes__block minutes__block--wide">
                <h3>Action items</h3>
                <ul className="minutes__actions-list">
                  {mi.actionItems.map((a, i) => (
                    <li key={i}>
                      <span>{a.task}</span>
                      {(a.owner || a.due) && (
                        <span className="minutes__meta">
                          {a.owner && <span>{a.owner}</span>}
                          {a.due && <span>Due {a.due}</span>}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            )}
            <MinutesList title="Open questions" items={mi.openQuestions} />
          </div>
          <p className="minutes__note">Written by Gemini from the transcript. Speaker names come from voice recognition, so check who owns what.</p>
        </article>
      )}

      {m.refined && (
        <p className="notes__memory">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">
            {m.memoryStatus === "error" ? "error" : "neurology"}
          </span>
          <span>
            {m.memoryStatus === "running" || memorizing
              ? "Adding what matters from this meeting to memoryâ€¦"
              : m.memoryStatus === "done"
                ? m.memoryCount
                  ? `Memory updated from this meeting: ${m.memoryCount} change${m.memoryCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}. You'll find them on the Memory page.`
                  : "Nothing from this meeting needed remembering."
                : m.memoryStatus === "error"
                  ? `Couldn't update memory from this meeting: ${m.memoryError}`
                  : "This meeting isn't in AURA's memory."}
          </span>
          {m.memoryStatus !== "running" && !memorizing && (
            <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" onClick={memorize}>
              {m.memoryStatus === "done" ? "Check again" : m.memoryStatus === "error" ? "Try again" : "Add to memory"}
            </button>
          )}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function MinutesList({ title, items }: { title: string; items: string[] }) {
  if (!items.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className="minutes__block">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      <ul>
        {items.map((t, i) => (
          <li key={i}>{t}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/MemoryReview.tsx

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";
import { api, MemoryProposal } from "../lib/api";

/**
 * Changes AURA wants to make to memories you already have. Nothing changes until you decide.
 * `signal` is any value that changes when there may be new proposals (e.g. the pending count).
 */
export default function MemoryReview({
  signal,
  compact,
  onChanged,
}: {
  signal?: unknown;
  compact?: boolean;
  onChanged?: () => void;
}) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<MemoryProposal[]>([]);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    api
      .get<MemoryProposal[]>("/api/memories/proposals")
      .then(setItems)
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);
  useEffect(load, [load, signal]);

  const decide = async (p: MemoryProposal, accept: boolean) => {
    setBusy(p.id);
    setError(null);
    try {
      if (accept) await api.post(`/api/memories/proposals/${p.id}/accept`, editing[p.id] != null ? { content: editing[p.id] } : {});
      else await api.post(`/api/memories/proposals/${p.id}/reject`);
      setEditing(({ [p.id]: _, ...rest }) => rest);
      load();
      onChanged?.();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const shown = compact ? items.slice(0, 1) : items;
  if (!items.length) return null;

  return (
    <section className={cn("review", { "review--compact": compact })} aria-label="Memory changes to review">
      {!compact && (
        <h2 className="review__title">
          Needs your OK <span className="review__count">{items.length}</span>
        </h2>
      )}
      {error && <p className="review__error">{error}</p>}
      {shown.map((p) => {
        const old = p.current?.content ?? "";
        const isEditing = editing[p.id] != null;
        return (
          <article key={p.id} className="review__card">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined review__icon" aria-hidden="true">
              {p.action === "update" ? "published_with_changes" : p.action === "retire" ? "history" : "delete"}
            </span>
            <div className="review__body">
              <p className="review__q">
                {p.action === "update"
                  ? "Update this memory?"
                  : p.action === "retire"
                    ? "Is this no longer true?"
                    : "You asked AURA to forget this. Delete it?"}
                {compact && items.length > 1 && <span className="muted"> ({items.length - 1} more on the Memory page)</span>}
              </p>
              <p className={cn("review__old", { "review__old--struck": p.action === "update" && !isEditing })}>{old}</p>
              {p.action === "update" &&
                (isEditing ? (
                  <textarea
                    className="review__edit"
                    value={editing[p.id]}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditing((x) => ({ ...x, [p.id]: e.target.value }))}
                    rows={2}
                    autoFocus
                    aria-label="New wording"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <p className="review__new">{p.content}</p>
                ))}
              <div className="review__actions">
                <button className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={busy === p.id} onClick={() => decide(p, true)}>
                  {p.action === "update" ? "Update" : p.action === "retire" ? "Mark outdated" : "Delete"}
                </button>
                {p.action === "update" && !isEditing && (
                  <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" disabled={busy === p.id} onClick={() => setEditing((x) => ({ ...x, [p.id]: p.content || "" }))}>
                    Edit first
                  </button>
                )}
                <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" disabled={busy === p.id} onClick={() => decide(p, false)}>
                  Keep as is
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </article>
        );
      })}
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/Orb.tsx

import cn from "classnames";

/**
 * AURA's mark: a glowing ring whose halo follows the audio level.
 * Used small in the sidebar and large as the voice button.
 */
export default function Orb({
  size = 120,
  level = 0,
  active = false,
  tone = "idle",
}: {
  size?: number;
  level?: number;
  active?: boolean;
  tone?: "idle" | "listening" | "speaking" | "recording";
}) {
  const l = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, level));
  return (
    <span
      className={cn("orb", `orb--${tone}`, { "orb--active": active })}
      style={{ width: size, height: size, ["--level" as any]: l.toFixed(3) }}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <span className="orb__halo" />
      <span className="orb__core" />
    </span>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";
import { useLiveAPIContext } from "../contexts/LiveAPIContext";
import { api, ConversationSummary } from "../lib/api";
import { relativeTime } from "../lib/format";
import Logo from "./Logo";
import { setFaviconState } from "../lib/favicon";

export type View = "assistant" | "memory" | "meeting";

type Props = {
  view: View;
  onView: (v: View) => void;
  historyId: number | null;
  onOpenHistory: (id: number | null) => void;
  historyVersion: number;
  onOpenSettings: () => void;
  memoryReviews: number;
};

const NAV: { id: View; label: string; icon: string }[] = [
  { id: "assistant", label: "Assistant", icon: "graphic_eq" },
  { id: "memory", label: "Memory", icon: "neurology" },
  { id: "meeting", label: "Meeting Mode", icon: "groups" },
];

export default function Sidebar({ view, onView, historyId, onOpenHistory, historyVersion, onOpenSettings, memoryReviews }: Props) {
  const { status, conversationId, messages, micOn, outVolume, micVolume } = useLiveAPIContext();
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<ConversationSummary[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => setFaviconState({ voice: status === "connected" }), [status]);
  const messageCount = messages.filter((m) => !m.pending).length;
  useEffect(() => {
    api
      .get<ConversationSummary[]>("/api/conversations")
      .then(setHistory)
      .catch(() => setHistory([]));
  }, [conversationId, messageCount, historyVersion]);

  const statusLabel =
    status === "connected" ? (micOn ? "Listening" : "Connected, mic off") : status === "connecting" ? "Connectingâ€¦" : "Voice offline";

  return (
    <aside className="sidebar">
      <div className="sidebar__brand">
        <Logo size={36} level={status === "connected" ? Math.max(outVolume * 4, micOn ? micVolume * 3 : 0) : 0} live={status === "connected"} />
      </div>

      <nav className="sidebar__nav" aria-label="Main">
        {NAV.map((n) => (
          <button
            key={n.id}
            className={cn("nav-item", { "nav-item--active": view === n.id && !(n.id === "assistant" && historyId) })}
            onClick={() => onView(n.id)}
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined">{n.icon}</span>
            {n.label}
            {n.id === "memory" && memoryReviews > 0 && (
              <span className="nav-item__badge" title={`${memoryReviews} memory change${memoryReviews === 1 ? "" : "s"} to review`}>
                {memoryReviews}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>

      <div className="sidebar__history">
        {history.length === 0 && (
          <>
            <h2 className="sidebar__heading">Conversations</h2>
            <p className="sidebar__empty">Past conversations will appear here.</p>
          </>
        )}
        {[
          { label: "Pinned", items: history.filter((c) => c.pinned) },
          { label: "Conversations", items: history.filter((c) => !c.pinned) },
        ]
          .filter((g) => g.items.length)
          .map((g) => (
            <div key={g.label} className="sidebar__group">
              <h2 className="sidebar__heading">{g.label}</h2>
              <ul>
                {g.items.map((c) => (
                  <li key={c.id}>
                    <button
                      className={cn("history-item", {
                        "history-item--active": historyId === c.id,
                        "history-item--live": c.id === conversationId && !historyId,
                      })}
                      onClick={() => onOpenHistory(c.id === conversationId ? null : c.id)}
                      title={c.title}
                    >
                      <span className="history-item__title">{c.title}</span>
                      <span className="history-item__meta">{c.id === conversationId ? "Current" : relativeTime(c.updatedAt)}</span>
                    </button>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          ))}
      </div>

      <div className="sidebar__footer">
        <div className={cn("status-pill", `status-pill--${status}`, { "status-pill--mic": micOn })} aria-live="polite">
          <span className="status-pill__dot" />
          {statusLabel}
        </div>
        <button className="icon-button" onClick={onOpenSettings} aria-label="Settings" title="Settings">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined">settings</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}

const TOOL_DECLARATIONS = [recallDeclaration, findMeetingsDeclaration, getMeetingDeclaration, askDocumentDeclaration];

type ToolContext = {
  conversationId: number | null;
